<div class="hero-name">Chandan Kumar</div>

### Assistant Professor, Computer Science
Alfred University, New York

<div class="home-tags">
<span>Computer Vision</span>
<span>Deep Learning</span>
<span>Unsupervised Learning</span>
<span>Multimodal Models</span>
</div>

I am an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at Alfred University and a researcher
in Computer Vision and Deep Learning, specializing in unsupervised learning, real-time
vision systems, and multimodal foundation models. I completed my Ph.D. at Iowa State
University, where my research focused on scalable computer vision methods for object
discovery, semantic segmentation, and building footprint reconstruction.

I worked at the intersection of theory and practice through research collaborations with
Oak Ridge National Laboratory, with publications in top-tier venues such as ICLR and
CVPR and support from NSF-funded projects. My work emphasizes developing robust,
real-world AI systems, and I actively contribute to the research community as a reviewer
for leading conferences including ECCV, ICML, and NeurIPS.

<script>
(function () {
  // Repeatable scroll reveal: elements animate in every time they cross the
  // viewport edge, in either scroll direction.
  const targets = document.querySelectorAll(".hero-columns, .news-item");
  targets.forEach((el) => el.classList.add("home-reveal"));

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        entry.target.classList.toggle("clavr-in-view", entry.isIntersecting);
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: "0px 0px -60px 0px" }
  );
  targets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("footprint-canvas");
  const page = canvas ? canvas.parentElement : null;
  if (!canvas || !page) return;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let width, height;
  const footprints = [];
  const LIFE_MS = 1700;
  const MIN_STEP = 30;
  let lastX = null;
  let lastY = null;
  let side = 1;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  function handleMove(e) {
    const rect = page.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (lastX === null) {
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
      return;
    }

    const dx = x - lastX;
    const dy = y - lastY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist >= MIN_STEP) {
      const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      side *= -1;
      footprints.push({ x, y, angle, side, born: performance.now() });
      if (footprints.length > 80) footprints.shift();
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
    }
  }

  page.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMove);
  page.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    lastX = null;
    lastY = null;
  });

  function drawFootprint(fp, now) {
    const age = now - fp.born;
    if (age > LIFE_MS) return false;

    const opacity = 0.55 * (1 - age / LIFE_MS);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(fp.x, fp.y);
    ctx.rotate(fp.angle + Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.translate(fp.side * 5, 0);
    ctx.scale(fp.side, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c5d85";

    // heel
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 11, 3.4, 5.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // arch (narrower waist of the sole)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-0.3, 3, 2.9, 5, -0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // ball of the foot (wider)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0.2, -5, 4.3, 5.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // toes: big toe (medial) down to little toe, graduated size
    const toes = [
      { dx: -3.4, dy: -10.8, r: 1.9 },
      { dx: -1.0, dy: -11.6, r: 1.5 },
      { dx: 1.2, dy: -11.3, r: 1.25 },
      { dx: 3.2, dy: -10.6, r: 1.05 },
      { dx: 4.7, dy: -9.4, r: 0.85 },
    ];
    toes.forEach((t) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(t.dx, t.dy, t.r, t.r * 1.25, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });

    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const now = performance.now();
    for (let i = footprints.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!drawFootprint(footprints[i], now)) {
        footprints.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
})();
</script>
